apparatus.selector: cKDTree unit-vector spherical radius search plus Astrolabe physical cuts

exploratory.label: exploratory; excluded from frozen primary verdict

protocol_matrix_arithmetic.resolution: executed every enumerated row/seed exactly; did not invent three runs

decision_rule.r0: all |median B_i| <= 1.5*realization sigma and chance <= 0.05 + sigma
decision_rule.r1: median |B_i| >= 0.04 and bootstrap band excludes zero
decision_rule.r4: 0.05/0.10 detected at >=2 realization sigma in >=80% of seeds
